signals.summary: A broad, cross-source wave celebrating unhurried journeys — long ocean voyages, scenic rail, wellness retreats and lingering stays over checklist tourism. Illustrates beautifully with serene, uncrowded places.
signals.why_now: ~13 independent items, many fresh: ABC News (38h), DTH slow rail Asia (54h), Oceania long voyages across 3 outlets (48-98h), DERTOUR slow/solo survey x2 (74-76h), Nomade Ibiza temple (72h), ScienceBlog evidence piece (136h), plus world-cruise booking surge (71h).

signals.summary: Overnight and scenic train journeys across Europe are having a moment — cheap sleepers, autumn rail routes and cross-border twin-city trips. Rich material for landscapes seen from carriage windows and cozy compartment interiors.
signals.why_now: ~8 independent scenic-rail items, several recent: inItaly historic UNESCO trains (16h), British Vogue 7-by-train (31h), Falstaff 'Fall by Rail' northern routes (54h), Travel Off Path $22 cross-city (71h), Telegraph cheapest sleeper (73h), Euronews twin-city sleepers (75h). EU single-ticket policy pieces gated out as regulation noise.

signals.summary: A steady pull toward off-the-beaten-path spots — quirky Atlas Obscura landmarks, underrated regional destinations and overlooked 'gem' towns. Perfect for striking, unfamiliar landscapes and oddities.
signals.why_now: Atlas Obscura pushed 8 fresh place listings (41-69h: Bunski Kanal Bosnia, Gin Drinkers Line Hong Kong, Isis Temple Mainz, Red Sea Terminal Egypt) alongside independent hidden-gem news: MLive U.P. gems (2h), plus T+L scenic island-chain and California underrated round-ups.

signals.summary: Autumn-travel round-ups are landing in force — weekend getaways, 'lore-tripping', groundhopping and an 'Asian Autumn' pivot away from Europe. Illustrates with fall foliage, cozy cityscapes and warm-toned landscapes.
signals.why_now: ~6 independent fall round-ups: Airbnb newsroom + Martha Stewart lore-tripping recap (68h), travelpulse fall-trends headline (90h), The Manual 'Asian Autumn' (66h), Airbnb 'fall beats summer' (120h), ELLE 9 fall trends. Seasonal window keeps older items live.

signals.summary: Millennials are booking nostalgia-fuelled trips — childhood-dream destinations and a Y2K/90s-00s revival, with Miami leaning into the aesthetic. Renders as retro-coded cityscapes and resort scenes.
signals.why_now: 3 independent items, one very fresh: Yahoo Y2K nostalgia holiday trend (4h), Bustle 'throwback trips' childhood dreams (45h), TravelMole 'Miami bets on Y2K revival' (51h).

signals.summary: Travellers increasingly treat foreign supermarkets as a must-visit attraction — the 'supermarket safari'. Photogenic aisles, packaged goods and local snacks make for strong food/interior imagery.
signals.why_now: 2 independent items with real engagement: BBC Travel feature on supermarkets as tourist attractions (172h, 53 pts / 61 comments on HN), Yahoo Creators 'supermarket safari' viral trend (150h). Evergreen viral aesthetic keeps it live past 48h.
